decisive_items: hyperkeratosis, distinct vacuolization in the granular and upper spinous layers, and bullae formation within the epidermis
heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1
response.rationale: Both candidates denote the same disorder; Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis is the more precise term for the histopathologic and genetic findings, while Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma is an older synonym.

rejected.why: Synonymous with Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis; the term is less specific to the histopathologic and genetic findings.
